threat_event: Business email compromise: a phishing email or MFA push fatigue gives an attacker a staff mailbox, where client source documents and returns are harvested
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA without number matching; legacy authentication allowed on 4 shared mailboxes; external auto-forwarding allowed; no inbox-rule alerting; clients email source documents
existing_controls: MFA (push); EDR on endpoints; annual training
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant or number-matching MFA; block legacy authentication and external auto-forwarding; alert on new inbox rules and impossible travel; phishing exercises before filing season (see P08)

threat_event: Attacker in a hijacked client email thread asks the firm to change the refund direct deposit account on a return
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No call-back verification for bank account changes requested by email
existing_controls: Preparers usually reuse prior-year bank details
treatment_plan: Written call-back procedure using a phone number on file for any change to bank, address, or email; train preparers and client service staff before 2027 filing season

threat_event: Stolen client data or a stolen EFIN is used to file fraudulent returns in clients' names
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Data theft would go unnoticed (no log review); EFIN totals are not checked (PTIN totals are)
existing_controls: Weekly PTIN returns-filed check in season
treatment_plan: Add weekly EFIN returns-filed check; data theft procedure with the IRS Stakeholder Liaison (P08)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the DMS, workpaper server, and endpoints during filing season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EDR alerts watched in business hours only; restore of workpaper server never tested; filing-season deadlines
treatment_plan: 24x7 managed detection and response through the MSP; quarterly restore tests of both servers; ransomware annex to the IR plan

threat_event: Attacker or insider exports large volumes of client files from the DMS without detection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No bulk export alerting; DMS logs never reviewed
treatment_plan: Send DMS, tax software, and identity logs to a log workspace; alert on bulk download; monthly review by the Qualified Individual

threat_event: A preparer's tax software account is taken over and used to view or alter many returns
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA; session reuse on shared seasonal stations
existing_controls: SSO with MFA for the tax software
treatment_plan: Number-matching MFA; named accounts on seasonal stations; review tax software access logs monthly

threat_event: A client's portal account is taken over with a reused password and the attacker downloads returns and source documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client MFA optional (38% enrolled)
treatment_plan: Require MFA for all client portal accounts before the 2027 filing season

threat_event: Returns and source documents sent as plain email attachments are misdirected or intercepted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff send files by unencrypted email on client request; autocomplete addressing
existing_controls: TLS between mail servers where supported
treatment_plan: Block outbound attachments with SSNs unless sent through the portal or encrypted mail; train staff

threat_event: A seasonal preparer's account is used after the season ends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Seasonal accounts disabled about 6 business days after season end; no access review
existing_controls: HR emails IT at end of season
treatment_plan: Set account expiry dates at creation; same-day disable from HR ticket; quarterly access review

threat_event: A partner's everyday account that holds global administrator rights is phished and used to take over the productivity suite and identity provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 partners hold standing global admin rights on daily accounts with push MFA
treatment_plan: Remove admin rights from partner daily accounts; separate admin accounts for IT only with phishing-resistant keys; two break-glass accounts

threat_event: Attacker exploits an unpatched flaw in the internet-facing remote access VPN gateway
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vulnerability scanning since 2025-03; no penetration test; gateway firmware updated ad hoc
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans; patch critical flaws within 14 days; annual external and internal penetration test starting 2026-11

threat_event: Staff paste client tax return information into public generative AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list before 2026-08; 3 staff did this
treatment_plan: Approved-tools list; block public chatbots on firm devices; training on IRC 7216 (see P10)

threat_event: The tax software's AI extraction feature sends tax return information to a sub-processor without taxpayer consent or with training rights
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot enabled before contract and IRC 7216 review
treatment_plan: Confirm U.S.-only processing, no training, and 301.7216-2(d)(2) written notice in the contract; obtain consent where required (see P10)

threat_event: AI-extracted amounts are wrong and flow into filed returns
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accuracy sampling in the pilot
existing_controls: Preparer review of every return; reviewer sign-off
treatment_plan: Field-level comparison sample of 20 returns per preparer each month; reviewer checklist item for AI-populated fields

threat_event: A breach exposes client files kept since 2009, multiplying the number of people to notify
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention and disposal schedule
treatment_plan: Adopt a retention schedule; dispose of customer information past the retention period under 314.4(c)(6); first purge 2027-06

threat_event: An unencrypted reception or scanning desktop is stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 desktops unencrypted; cached scans
treatment_plan: Full-disk encryption on all desktops

threat_event: Scanned tax documents are recovered from a leased multifunction printer drive after return to the lessor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Printer-scanner drives keep images; no wipe at lease end
treatment_plan: Enable image overwrite; require drive wipe certificate from the lessor

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool gives attackers access to every endpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has unrestricted access; MSP contract has no security terms
treatment_plan: Add security terms to the MSP contract; restrict tool access by source; annual MSP assessment

threat_event: Tax software vendor outage in the last week before the April or October deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single tax software vendor; no manual fallback
treatment_plan: Deadline contingency plan: file extensions early, prioritize clients, paper filing as last resort

threat_event: Breach at the tax software vendor exposes the firm's client data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firm relies on vendor controls; complementary user entity controls partly unmet
treatment_plan: Close the complementary controls gaps (see P09); contract notice of security incidents

threat_event: Hurricane closes the Main office for several days during extension season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written contingency plan; key staff live near the coast
existing_controls: Cloud-hosted systems; laptops for all professionals
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with remote work and Branch office relocation

threat_event: Internet outage at the Branch office
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ISP at the Branch office
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low; staff relocate to home or Main office

threat_event: FTC enforcement after a breach because required program elements were missing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written risk assessment, IR plan, or annual report to the Partner Group before 2026
existing_controls: 2026 risk assessment and gap analysis (this work)
treatment_plan: Update the WISP; adopt the IR plan; first written report to the Partner Group 2026-10-20

threat_event: Data theft is reported late to the IRS, states, the FTC, or affected individuals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No data theft procedure; staff unaware of next-business-day e-file report
treatment_plan: Notification matrix and runbook (P08); tabletop before filing season

threat_event: Attacker impersonates a firm vendor and changes its remittance bank account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No call-back verification for vendor payment changes
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for vendor bank changes (same procedure as R-002)

threat_event: A preparer misuses client data for identity theft or sells it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review of user activity; broad access to all client files
treatment_plan: Limit DMS access by team; monthly activity review; IRC 7216 acknowledgment at hire

threat_event: An unreviewed firewall or cloud network change exposes the DMS to the internet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change management procedure
treatment_plan: Lightweight change procedure with approval and monthly rule review

threat_event: Restore of the audit workpaper server fails when needed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Workpaper server restore never tested
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests of both servers

threat_event: Tax return information is released to a lender or other third party without a valid signed consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consent form not always signed before release
treatment_plan: Portal workflow requires a signed consent before release

threat_event: Denial of service against the client portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted; outside firm control
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: A staff laptop is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel to client sites
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption on all laptops; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes disclosure unlikely; residual risk Low

threat_event: A scanned document is filed to the wrong client and shared through the portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual indexing of scans at intake
treatment_plan: Barcode cover sheets at intake; spot checks

threat_event: Attacker uses the shared intake mailbox password, which works without MFA over legacy authentication, to read client uploads and send spoofed requests
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared password known to 6 staff and unchanged since 2024; legacy authentication enabled (found in P07 testing)
treatment_plan: Convert to a shared mailbox with delegated access only; block legacy authentication; rotate credential
